## 📖 Reports
This report takes a risk mitigation approach to answer questions regarding prison capacity in the next 5 years. The report details the underlying research behind the development of the projections displayed on the dashboard which has been selected from a range of models. 

```{r}
#| label: pdf-embed
#| echo: false

library(htmltools)  

HTML('
<div class="header">
  <a href="https://www.canva.com/design/DAGknp8Yjjk/dIuFsRix5H9n78RKTyBQQg/view?utm_content=DAGknp8Yjjk&utm_campaign=designshare&utm_medium=link2&utm_source=uniquelinks&utlId=hd7c13c3d3c" target="_blank">
  <h3>April 2025 Capacity Report</h3>
  </a>
  <br>
</div>
')

htmltools::tags$iframe(
  src = "Utah-Prison-Projections-Capacity-Final-Report-April-2025.pdf",
  width = "100%",
  height = "700px",
  style = "border: 1px solid #ddd;"
)

```

## 📝 Resources
This is an example tutorial of the Stock Flow Model adapted for Utah data. This resource was developed through the literature review process and interviewing other states' methods in prison projections. This resource may support alternative ways to project prison projections for future iterations of this project.

```{r}
#| label: pdf-embed2
#| echo: false

library(htmltools)
```
